_about: Every string on the Config screen (scripts/ui/config_screen.gd). {ms}, {n} and similar words in braces are filled in by the screen.
title: Config
back_hint: Left/right changes a value. Cancel goes back.

auto_timing.label: Auto-Timing
auto_timing.hint: Battle timing presses themselves. Off by default.

wide_windows.label: Wide Windows
wide_windows.hint: Bigger timing windows. You still press.

battle_camera.label: Battle Camera
battle_camera.hint: Dynamic pans and cranes around the fight. Calm keeps one steady view.

timing_offset.label: Timing Offset
timing_offset.hint: Nudge the timing for laggy TVs and headphones.

tap_along.label: Tap-Along Test
tap_along.hint: Tap along to a beat and find your best offset.

text_speed.label: Text Speed
text_speed.hint: How fast the speech bubbles type out.

auto_advance.label: Auto-Advance
auto_advance.hint: Finished text turns by itself. Hold Cancel to hurry text.

skip_seen.label: Skip Seen Cutscenes
skip_seen.hint: Let a cutscene you have watched be skipped.

voice_volume.label: Voice Volume
voice_volume.hint: How loud the gibberish voices are.

vibration.label: Vibration
vibration.hint_no_pad: No controller found. Saved for when you plug one in.

preview.text: The quick brown pup jumps over the lazy lamp.
preview.speaker: otis

controls.title: Controls
controls.hint: Pick a button, left/right picks keyboard or controller.
controls.capture_hint_key: Press the new key. Esc cancels.
controls.capture_hint_pad: Press the new button. Right-click cancels.
controls.reserved: That one is taken (movement, Esc and F-keys can't be changed).
controls.reset_hint: Put every button back the way it was.

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.hint: Back out. Hold to speed up text.

interact.label: Talk / Examine
interact.hint: Talk to people, examine and pick things up.

light.label: Attack
light.hint: Sword attack. Keep pressing it: Red picks the right move for the moment.

heavy.label: Hack (coming later)
heavy.hint: Reserved for Red's hacker powers. For now it only shows a note.

dash.label: Dash
dash.hint: Dodge in any direction. Safe for a moment at the start.

parry.label: Parry
parry.hint: Brace just before a hit lands to block or parry it.

lock_on.label: Lock On
lock_on.hint: Lock onto the nearest enemy, or let go.

camera_toggle.label: Camera Style
camera_toggle.hint: Switch between the free camera and the diorama camera.

feel_panel.label: Feel Knobs
feel_panel.hint: Open the panel that tunes how the game feels. F12 is fixed; the pad button can change.

tap_along.title: Tap-Along Test
tap_along.intro_1: A light will flash and ding on a steady beat.
tap_along.late: Your taps ran about {ms} ms late.
tap_along.early: Your taps ran about {ms} ms early.
tap_along.on_time: Your taps landed right on the beat.
tap_along.unsteady: Those taps were a bit uneven. You can still use it, or try again.
tap_along.too_few: Not enough good taps to tell. Try again.
tap_along.messy: The taps were all over the place. Try again, nice and steady.
